assembly.gaps: every inter-phrase gap is gated to true digital silence (adaptive threshold = noise floor p10 + 12 dB, ~18 ms fades) — kills the constant ~91 Hz hum the IndicF5 route leaves in pauses
assembly.level_match: plain gain only — each sentence take is gain-matched to the median speech RMS of the set (no dynamics processing; stacked processing audibly ate the voice identity in audits)
assembly.loudnorm: ONE single-pass ffmpeg loudnorm to approx -15 LUFS at the very end; never stack loudnorm passes

JULIE_EL_VOICE_ID — or set voice_id in this section
JULIE_TTS_URL (required) — your model server's TTS endpoint

backends.note: Pluggable generation backends (see backends.py). Default per language: en -> chatterbox, te/hi -> indicf5-space. Env JULIE_TTS_BACKEND overrides the route for any language; valid values: indicf5-space | chatterbox | elevenlabs | http. The five gates, the re-roll loop and the QC report apply unchanged on top of every backend, and each take's backend is recorded in the QC report. gates.head_bleed_note: Gate 8 HEAD BLEED (2026-11-17): ACTIVE. A te/hi take whose head window (2.4 s from speech onset, forced-language decode, thresholds disabled) legibly carries the DEFAULT reference passage tail phrase (natspan2 closing words, phonetic match), or whose pre-script speech cannot be rendered phonetically, or in which none of the script opening is recognizable, FAILS in ship_decision (blocked_by gate8_head_bleed) and the engine re-rolls; the measurement is recorded on every take regardless (QC key gate8_head_bleed). Calibration 2026-11-17 (test_head_bleed.py): the two convicted gate-2 ear-check takes FAIL (tail match 0.89 / 0.87); the ear-approved fixed13 takes PASS (their natspan3 tail echo 0.84 is recorded as advisory tail_echo, not failed -- the owner approved those takes with it); her genuine natspan1/2/3 reference spans PASS against their own transcripts. Non-default reference tail echoes are recorded, never failed. fw-base renders this voice openings in Tamil/Arabic/Latin script salad (genuine narration included); gate 8 transliterates Tamil tokens itself and fails only the legible convicted signature, unrenderable lead speech, or a wholly unrecognizable head.
gates.tail_grunt_note: Gate 9 TAIL GRUNT (2026-11-17, branch feat/tail-grunt-gate): ACTIVE for te/hi. The mirror of gate 8 at the END of the take: voiced phonation continuing past the script's last word (the 'rey / eyh' sounds Ajju caught at sentence ends in the turbo TE/HI samples). Measured on the shipped samples: the grunt is GLUED to the last word (no silence gap; sub-threshold dips < 40 ms), so island tail-trims missed it and Whisper folds it into the last word; one shipped Telugu sentence carries 80 ms of phonation past the aligner's last-word end at a dead-flat 140 Hz (IQR 5) — the head grunt's signature (139-168 Hz flat) at the tail. Rule: acoustic phonation end (floor + 8 dB islands) more than 60 ms past the aligner's last-word end, where the residual segment is voiced (allowance calibrated 2026-11-17: clean shipped finals measure residual <= 0.03 s, the convicted grunt 0.08 s), FAILS the take in ship_decision (blocked_by gate9_tail_grunt) and the engine re-rolls; repair class tail_grunt escalates route like head bleed. In the TURBO finishing path the same detection may instead CUT a cleanly separable grunt at the last-word end with the locked 45 ms tail fade, proven by a CER re-check (a reverted cut fails the take — a cut last word never ships, gate 7 law). Detection: acoustic_gates.tail_grunt_detect (ASR-anchored mode; conservative dip-split acoustic fallback when no aligner words exist) + turbo.tail_grunt_check. Honest limit: a grunt folded entirely INSIDE the aligner's last-word span is indistinguishable from the word's natural release with these instruments and is not convicted.
gates.note: ALL gates must pass on the SAME take. A sentence with no passing take in max_rolls rolls fails the whole run: the engine exits non-zero with the gate table and writes NO final mp3.
gates.ship_bar_te_hi: EAR-APPROVED BAR (Ajju, 2026-11-16, fixed13 — the first Telugu ear-pass): a te/hi take ships iff gate1 (no-hint language) AND gate2 (ghost scan) pass AND Resemblyzer identity >= identity_min_te_hi AND pace within pace_wps_te_hi, all on the SAME whole take. Gates 3/4/5 are still computed and recorded on every take but are ADVISORY for te/hi: the fixed6 calibration proved the identical suite fails her own genuine narration (g3 min word-prob 0.000-0.326; PHYS flags on real spans), and the ear-approved fixed13 takes do not pass all of g3/g4/g5 (S1 F0 184.2 Hz vs the 185 band edge). ship_decision() in engine.py is the single implementation of this bar; a take that cannot be measured fails closed, and a sentence with no passing take in the roll budget ships NOTHING (exit 2).
gates.whole_take_note: te/hi ship rule (Ajju order 2026-11-16, after the 2026-11-15 ear rejections of fixed2/fixed3/fixed5; bar recalibrated to the ear-approved anchor the same day, fixed13): WHOLE-TAKE ONLY — a te/hi sentence ships only from ONE take passing the ear-approved bar in gates.ship_bar_te_hi (gate1 + gate2 + identity >= identity_min_te_hi + pace within pace_wps_te_hi). No clause/donor assembly, no splice inside a sentence. Roll budgets above local_roll_limit_te_hi are dispatched to the indicf5-batch.yml mass-roll workflow instead of rolling locally.
